W55

Announcement editor

/teach/courses/:courseId/announcements/:announcementId/edit
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S13, S03

Draft, target, schedule and publish course announcements with a reviewable audience and truthful delivery status.

Entry and return
W28 staff authoring actionW35 course communicationW08 course activity source
Layout regions
EditorTitle, accessible body and course resource links
Audience/scheduleEntire course or explicit enrolled subsets, publication time and timezone
Preview/statusLearner view, revision comparison, publication and delivery history

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Publish announcement
  • Exact audience count, selected subset labels, time and learner preview
  • Notification preferences affect delivery; publication is separately recorded
Return without applying changesPublish or confirm schedule
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Scheduling an announcement does not show it to learners before publication.
  • Failed email delivery leaves one published announcement with retry status.
  • TA can draft only within explicit course authoring scope and cannot publish to a class.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
